title: EMG Tokenization Preserves Movement Information at a Fraction of the Bitrate
abstract: arXiv:2610.32674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wireless electromyography (EMG) interfaces must balance electrode coverage against transmission bandwidth. Here, we show that compact EMG tokens substantially reduce payload while retaining information for three-dimensional hand-pose decoding. We evaluate two causal tokenizers fitted without pose labels: an encoder pretrained to reconstruct EMG spectra and one based on SPAR, an engineered spectral-spatial representation of neighbouring electrodes. In personalized, within-session experiments with 320-channel EMG from nine participants, we compare tokenized and continuous features using matched decoder architectures and training procedures. Averaged across decoders, tokenization changed mean error by +0.01 mm for SPAR (95% confidence interval: -0.12 to 0.14) and +0.45 mm for the learned representation (0.10 to 0.82). translated_abstract: 无线肌电图（EMG）接口必须在电极覆盖范围与传输带宽之间取得平衡。本研究表明，紧凑的EMG标记在大幅减少数据负载的同时，能够保留用于三维手部姿态解码的信息。我们评估了两种无需姿态标签即可训练的因果标记器：一种是预训练用于重建EMG频谱的编码器，另一种基于SPAR——一种针对邻近电极的工程化频谱-空间表示。在使用九名参与者320通道EMG的个性化、会话内实验中，我们采用匹配的解码器架构和训练流程，对标记化特征与连续特征进行了比较。在各解码器上取平均后，标记化使SPAR的平均误差变化为+0.01毫米（95%置信区间：-0.12至0.14），学习型表示为+0.45毫米（0.10至0.82）。两者的误差增加均满足1毫米的非劣效性标准。存储的标记阵列相对于原始EMG数据将负载降低了41倍，并且……
tldr: 该研究提出无需姿态标签的EMG标记化方法，在将数据负载降低约41倍的情况下，三维手部姿态解码精度几乎不受影响。
